C1725.title: Conviction of Cai Kunmiao, Operator of the "Xingyuan" App
C1725.summary: In 2019, police shut down the "Xingyuan" app, which was used to fabricate over 100 million retweets for celebrities on Weibo. Its operator, Cai Kunmiao, generated nearly 8 million yuan in illicit profits within a year. The app intercepted data packets and decompiled code to obtain server interfaces, injecting fake clicks and reposts into the Weibo platform to enable bulk engagement manipulation. T
